prompt: Which principle should guide how permissions are assigned to agents?
explanation: Correct answer: B) Least-privilege — scope permissions to only what is required for the agent's defined tasks

options.text: Maximum privilege — agents should be able to do anything a senior engineer can do
Least-privilege — scope permissions to only what is required for the agent's defined tasks
Role inheritance — agents automatically inherit the permissions of the user who created them
Dynamic escalation — agents request elevated permissions when needed
